Purpose: Unique identifier for each cell (used as the index of MappingSummary.csv.gz).
Number of read pairs that entered Cutadapt (raw demultiplexed reads before trimming and filtering).
Total base pairs in the input read pairs, summed over R1 and R2.
Number of read pairs that survived Cutadapt adapter trimming and length/quality filtering, i.e. read pairs written to the trimmed fastq.
Number of R1 reads in which Cutadapt detected and trimmed adapter sequence.
Number of R1 bases trimmed off due to low base quality.
Total R1 base pairs remaining after adapter + quality trimming.
Number of R2 reads in which Cutadapt detected and trimmed adapter sequence.
Number of R2 bases trimmed off due to low base quality.
Total R2 base pairs remaining after adapter + quality trimming.
Number of uniquely mapped reads from the initial paired-end hisat-3n alignment of trimmed reads.
Comment: = 2 x (concordantly 1 time pairs) + 2 x (discordantly 1 time pairs) + (unpaired Aligned 1 time reads). Parsed from `*.hisat3n_dna_summary.txt`.

Purpose: Percent of uniquely mapped reads in the paired-end hisat-3n run, relative to total input reads (read pairs x 2).
Comment: 100 x UniqueMappedReads / total_reads. total_reads = read pairs x 2; the SE 'Total unpaired reads' are mates of pairs that failed PE mapping, i.e. a subset of read pairs x 2, so they are NOT added to the denominator. Note: the same cell_parser_hisat_summary formula is used for the mc and mct pipelines too, on both the DNA (`*.hisat3n_dna_summary.txt`) and RNA (`*.hisat3n_rna_summary.txt`) paired-end summaries, not only snm3C.

Purpose: Number of multi-mapped reads in the paired-end hisat-3n run.
Comment: = 2 x (concordantly >1 times pairs) + (unpaired Aligned >1 times reads).

Purpose: Percent of multi-mapped reads in the paired-end hisat-3n run, relative to total input reads.
Overall mapped percentage in the paired-end hisat-3n run.

Number of uniquely mapped R1 reads in the single-end re-alignment of split reads. R1 mates of read pairs that failed paired-end mapping are split at putative ligation (cut) sites and re-aligned with hisat-3n in single-end mode.
Percent of uniquely mapped R1 split-reads in the SE re-alignment, relative to all R1 split-reads input to that step.
Number of multi-mapped R1 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Percent of multi-mapped R1 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Overall mapped percentage for R1 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Number of uniquely mapped R2 reads in the single-end re-alignment of split reads (analogous to R1UniqueMappedReads).
Percent of uniquely mapped R2 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Number of multi-mapped R2 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Percent of multi-mapped R2 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Overall mapped percentage for R2 split-reads in the SE re-alignment.
Number of reads remaining after merging PE + R1-SE + R2-SE alignments and removing PCR duplicates with Picard MarkDuplicates.
Number of reads marked as PCR duplicates by Picard (paired duplicates counted as 2 plus unpaired duplicates).
Integer percent PCR duplication rate from Picard.
Number of non-split read pairs where both mates map to the same chromosome (cis contact from one ligation junction).
Number of read pairs that were split from a single read at a putative ligation (enzyme cut) site, with both resulting fragments mapping to the same chromosome.
Cis contacts coming from a read pair that yields multiple contacts (multi-way / multi-junction read), without split-at-cut-site.
Cis contacts coming from a read pair that was split at the cut site AND yields multiple contacts.
Number of non-split read pairs whose two mates map to different chromosomes (trans contact from one ligation junction).
Read pairs split at the ligation cut site whose resulting fragments map to different chromosomes.
Trans contacts coming from a multi-junction read pair (non-cut).
Trans contacts coming from a read pair split at the cut site AND yielding multiple contacts.
Reads split at locations OTHER than a recognized ligation cut site; likely artifactual chimeras from library prep rather than real chromatin contacts.
Read pairs that did not yield a usable chromatin contact.
Total mapped fragments going into chromatin-contact calling, before contact-level deduplication.
Total unique chromatin contacts remaining after contact-level deduplication.
Duplication rate of chromatin contacts.
Sum of all cis contact categories.
Sum of all trans contact categories.
Sum of all multi-junction contact categories (cis and trans, with and without cut).
Fraction of mapped fragments that became cis contacts.
Fraction of mapped fragments that became trans contacts.
Fraction of mapped fragments that became multi-junction contacts.
Number of methylated cytosine basecalls in CCC trinucleotide context, aggregated from the cell's ALLC file.
Comment: CCC is used as a proxy for the bisulfite non-conversion rate.

Purpose: Number of methylated cytosine basecalls in CG (CpG) context, aggregated from the cell's ALLC file.
Number of methylated cytosine basecalls in CH context (CA/CC/CT), aggregated from the cell's ALLC file.
Total cytosine basecall coverage in CCC context.
Total cytosine basecall coverage in CG context.
Total cytosine basecall coverage in CH context.
Fraction of methylated cytosines in CCC context; estimate of bisulfite non-conversion rate.
Global mCG methylation level.
Global mCH methylation level.
